 Reporting Center: “Aryabhatta Seminar Hall”, First Floor, First Year Building,  
Priyadarshini Campus, Opposite Lata Mangeshkar Hospital, Hingna Road, Nagpur. ph.no. 07104-299681. 
The following must be kept ready at the time of reporting:  
Student has to report to Institute and submit all required original documents along with Institute fees to be paid by the student 
before stipulated time limit given by the Admission authority. 
 
A. 
Students and parents must be present in person for reporting in college otherwise reporting will not be done (NO PROXY 
allowed). Please note that at the time reporting bring Original Identity proof any one of the following: (Aadhar 
Card/PAN Card/Driving License/ College Identity Card/ Voter ID card) otherwise admission not confirmed by 
the college. 
B. 
Admission fees are to be kept ready. (Full fees shall be accepted in crossed demand draft in favour of the “Principal, 
Priyadarshini College of Engineering” Payable at Nagpur.) or CASH  or  ONLINE. 
C.
